name: Organic Skincare Gift Set
description:
Pamper your skin with our 6-piece organic skincare set. Formulated with natural ingredients like aloe vera, rose water, vitamin C, and hyaluronic acid. Free from parabens, sulfates, and artificial fragrances. Perfect for all skin types.

**What's Inside:**
1. Vitamin C Face Wash (150ml)
2. Rose Water Toner (200ml)
3. Hyaluronic Acid Serum (30ml)
4. Aloe Vera Moisturizer (100ml)
5. Under Eye Cream (20ml)
6. Organic Face Mask (50g)

Plus a FREE gift box and skincare guide!
